thread:
lee: quick postmortem from onboarding call: sample-app (js sdk, fncall + jsonMode) delivered array elements as escaped JSON strings to our zod validator, failing validation.

nora: can you share the raw vs received payload?

lee: raw model output:
```json
{"records":[{"id":"r1","val":10},{"id":"r2","val":20}]}
```
what validator got:
```json
{"records":["{\"id\":\"r1\",\"val\":10}","{\"id\":\"r2\",\"val\":20}"]}
```

peter: ok that's the sanitizer converting array members to strings. is this only on js side?

lee: yes, python samples unaffected. appears when JSON_MODE=1 and using the helper that normalizes tool outputs.

nora: pragmatic fix: add an opt-in env var PARSE_ARRAY_ELEMENT_STRINGS=true so the sanitizer attempts JSON.parse on string elements that look like JSON (starts with { or [) and are under 8k chars. Default remains off. Enable for demo env.

peter: add telemetry event sanitizer.array_element_parsed with outcome success/fail and sdk_version. helps decide if we should flip default later.

lee: branch pushed with unit tests and docs updates: github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/branch/gh-334-parse-array-elements. CI triggered.

ci-bot: CI job 7902 queued for commit e9d4...

nora: nice. please ensure top-level stringified objects are not auto-parsed (we keep that behavior). test for mixed arrays (strings, numbers, object-strings) added?

peter: yes tests cover mixed arrays and nested arrays. merging once CI green.

ci-bot: CI passed, PR merged. release build scheduled (release/0.10.4).

lee: enabled PARSE_ARRAY_ELEMENT_STRINGS in the onboarding demo docker compose. will monitor telemetry for 14 days and update issue #3177 with results. thanks all for the quick turnaround.
